recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: marathon medals stamped with the wrong stadium skyline
a small model reverse-engineers unfamiliar code in thirty minutes
peace roadmap sketched between rebels and government
overcast summer night in San Francisco, thirteen degrees
late August Sunday, fog holding the bay

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Stamp marathon medals by tracing stadium silhouettes on a descending press — but the reference keeps swapping to the wrong city. Trace the correct skyline before the stamp fires.
composer-2.5-fast.touch_control: drag to trace the silhouette outline
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: one clean stamp lands perfectly centered before the conveyor advances
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: silhouettes blur together and the press timer shrinks each round
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: embossed foil medal, minimalist line art

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Decompile a glitching chip by snapping code fragments into place — each correct fit peels back another layer before a thirty-minute countdown expires.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.touch_control: tap to snap fragments into slots
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: satisfying cascade as each layer unlocks the next
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: fragments rotate, decoy pieces appear, timer bleeds faster
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: terminal green phosphor on black glass

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sail a one-thumb dinghy through San Francisco fog — swipe to tack between buoy lanes as visibility shrinks to a few meters ahead.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.touch_control: swipe left or right to tack
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: threading a narrow gap between buoys in one fluid motion
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: fog thickens, buoys drift off-course, wind gusts push you wide

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Draw a peace path connecting two warring dots on a grid — but rogue agents keep rerouting your line mid-stroke. Hold to draw, release to commit before they rewrite it.
gemini-3.1-pro.touch_control: hold and release to commit path segments
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: locking in a clean segment despite constant rerouting
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more agents intervene, hold windows shrink, grid splits into islands
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: hand-drawn treaty parchment with ink bleed
